// ==========================================================================
// THE BLOOD SET'S PLACEMENT PAGES -- where each gun sits in your hand.
//
// GENERATED by _pending/tools/make_menudef.py from WMCARD.blood, alongside that set's
// CVARINFO. Both come off the same card and the same stem rule, so a slider cannot name
// a cvar that does not exist. DO NOT EDIT -- change the card and run it again.
//
// EVERY SLIDER HERE MOVES THE GUN WHILE THE MENU IS OPEN. These are renderer-read cvars;
// a menu freezes the playsim, so a slider on a script-read cvar would move nothing at the
// one moment it is wanted. That is what the LINT-LIVE lines declare and what menu_lint
// checks.
// ==========================================================================

// LINT-LIVE: WM_Place_Blood
OptionMenu "WM_Place_Blood"
{
	Title "BLOOD -- WHERE EACH GUN SITS"
	StaticText "Pick a gun, then drag. It moves in your hand as you drag it.", 1
	StaticText "Put the gun in your hand first -- you are adjusting what you can see.", "DarkGray"
	StaticText ""
	Submenu "BL_FlareGun", "WM_Place_Blood_bl_flaregun"
	Submenu "BL_LifeLeech", "WM_Place_Blood_bl_lifeleech"
	Submenu "BL_Lighter", "WM_Place_Blood_bl_lighter"
	Submenu "BL_Napalm", "WM_Place_Blood_bl_napalm"
	Submenu "BL_Pitchfork", "WM_Place_Blood_bl_pitchfork"
	Submenu "BL_Shotgun", "WM_Place_Blood_bl_shotgun"
	Submenu "BL_Sigil", "WM_Place_Blood_bl_sigil"
	Submenu "BL_SprayCan", "WM_Place_Blood_bl_spraycan"
	Submenu "BL_TeslaGun", "WM_Place_Blood_bl_teslagun"
	Submenu "BL_Dynamite", "WM_Place_Blood_bl_dynamite"
	Submenu "BL_TommyGun", "WM_Place_Blood_bl_tommygun"
	Submenu "BL_Voodoo", "WM_Place_Blood_bl_voodoo"
}

{
	Submenu "VR Weapons -- Blood: where each gun sits", "WM_Place_Blood"
}

	StaticText ""
	StaticText "HOW BIG IT IS -- MOVES LIVE", "Gold"

	Slider "Size along X", "bl_flaregun_scale_x", 0.05, 3.0, 0.01, 2
